headline: Police officer and dispatcher appointments, and eligibility lists for patrol officer and probationary firefighter.
summary: The agenda covers appointments to police officer and public safety dispatcher jobs. It also covers certifying eligibility lists from the 2026 hiring process.
items: Consideration of one (1) lateral appointment to the position of Police Officer Grade II with the Central Falls Police Department
Consideration of three (3) appointments to the position of Public Safety Dispatcher with the Central Falls Police Department
Certification of eligibility list for Patrol Officer Grade II from the 2026 hiring process
Certification of eligibility list for Probationary Firefighter from the 2026 hiring process
location: Council Chambers, Central Falls City Hall, 580 Broad St., Central Falls, RI 02863
